mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level does not predict positive 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% does not predict positive 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strengthening labor market conditions, which reduces recession risk and boosts corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises from prior month
failure_condition: In periods of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals improving consumer confidence and economic activity, which reduces the risk of further earnings deterioration, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In recessionary periods, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening economic activity, which increases the risk of corporate earnings contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO level does not predict negative 5-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a severe labor market deterioration that increases the risk of recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% does not predict negative 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust residential construction activity, which supports economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST level does not predict positive 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in the federal funds rate and increase in the consumer price index indicates a stagflationary risk, which increases uncertainty and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises from prior month
failure_condition: In periods of concurrent FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
